method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 伊林家的房子坐落在离东河不远的一条街的尽头。
facts.anchor: The house sits at the end of a street not far from the East River.

facts.fact: 哈蒂从照片上猜测伊林的儿子欧文大概四五岁，可能已到上学年龄。
facts.anchor: she guesses Eeling’s son Owen is maybe four or five—possibly school age

facts.fact: 娜塔莉身高至少五英尺十英寸，深色头发向后梳，颧骨高、眼睛深棕。
facts.anchor: Natalie is tall, at least five ten, maybe more, with dark hair pulled back from high cheekbones and deep brown eyes.

facts.fact: 哈蒂说明来意后，娜塔莉认出她所说的报道是《The Bedfellow》。
娜塔莉说她与丈夫当时正在离婚，不愿为此承担责任。
facts.anchor: We were in the middle of a divorce.

facts.fact: 娜塔莉告诉哈蒂她把伊林的东西全扔掉了。
娜塔莉在哈蒂快走到车边时追出来问「你就是那个人吧，那个母亲」。
娜塔莉说伊林曾讲过他要去找哈蒂，但她当时并不相信。
facts.anchor: He said he was going to find you. I didn’t believe him.

facts.fact: 娜塔莉点头后把门完全打开，让哈蒂进屋。
facts.anchor: Natalie nods to herself and opens the door fully.
